verses.modern: Then Philip began with that very passage of Scripture and told Him the good news about Jesus.

verses.kjv: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
verses.modern: As they traveled along the road, they came to some water and the eunuch said, "Look, here is water. What prevents me from being baptized?"

verses.kjv: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.
verses.modern: Philip said, "If you believe with all your heart, you may." The eunuch answered, "I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God."

verses.kjv: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
verses.modern: He gave orders to stop the chariot. Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water and Philip baptized him.

verses.kjv: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
verses.modern: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord suddenly took Philip away, and the eunuch did not see him again, but went on His way rejoicing.

verses.kjv: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.
verses.modern: Philip, however, appeared at Azotus and traveled through that region, preaching the gospel in all the towns until he reached Caesarea.

chapters.summary: A great persecution scattered the church from Jerusalem, and Philip went down to Samaria where many believed and were baptized. Philip then met the Ethiopian eunuch on the road to Gaza, preached Jesus to him from Isaiah, and baptized him after the eunuch confessed his faith in Christ.

verses.kjv: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
verses.modern: Meanwhile, Saul was still threatening to kill the Lord's disciples. He went to the high priest

verses.kjv: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.
verses.modern: and asked him for letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any there who belonged to the Way — whether men or women — he might take them as prisoners to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:
verses.modern: As he neared Damascus on his journey, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.

verses.kjv: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
verses.modern: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, "Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?"

verses.kjv: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
verses.modern: "Who are You, Lord?" Saul asked. "I am Jesus, whom You are persecuting," He replied. "It is hard for You to kick against the goads."

verses.kjv: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
verses.modern: Trembling and astonished, Saul asked, "Lord, what do you want me to do?" The Lord said to Him, "Get up and go into the city. You will be told what you must do."

verses.kjv: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
verses.modern: The men traveling with Saul stood there speechless; they heard the sound but did not see anyone.

verses.kjv: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
verses.modern: Saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes he could see nothing. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.

verses.kjv: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.
verses.modern: For three days he was blind and did not eat or drink anything.

verses.kjv: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.
verses.modern: In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. The Lord called to Him in a vision, "Ananias!" "Yes, Lord," He answered.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
verses.modern: The Lord told Him, "Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying."

verses.kjv: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
verses.modern: "In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight."

verses.kjv: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
verses.modern: "Lord," Ananias answered, "I have heard many reports about this man and all the harm he has done to your people in Jerusalem."

verses.kjv: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.
verses.modern: "And he has come here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on Your name."

verses.kjv: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
verses.modern: But the Lord said to Ananias, "Go! This man is My chosen instrument to carry My name before the Gentiles and their kings and before the people of Israel."

verses.kjv: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.
verses.modern: "I will show him how much he must suffer for My name."

verses.kjv: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
verses.modern: Then Ananias went to the house and entered it. Placing His hands on Saul, he said, "Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, Who appeared to You on the road as You were coming here, has sent me so that You may see again and be filled with the Holy Ghost."

verses.kjv: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
verses.modern: Immediately, something like scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he could see again. He got up and was baptized.

verses.kjv: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
verses.modern: After taking some food, he regained his strength. Saul spent several days with the disciples in Damascus.

verses.kjv: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
verses.modern: At once He began to preach in the synagogues that Jesus is the Son of God.

verses.kjv: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?
verses.modern: All those who heard him were astonished and asked, "Isn't he the man who caused havoc in Jerusalem among those who call on this name? And hasn't he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?"

verses.kjv: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
verses.modern: Yet Saul grew more and more powerful and baffled the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Christ.

verses.kjv: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:
verses.modern: After many days had gone by, the Jewish leaders conspired to kill Him.

verses.kjv: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.
verses.modern: But Saul learned of their plot. Day and night they kept watch at the city gates in order to kill him.

verses.kjv: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.
verses.modern: But his followers took him by night and lowered him in a basket through an opening in the wall.

verses.kjv: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
verses.modern: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he really was a disciple.

verses.kjv: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
verses.modern: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles. He told them how Saul on his journey had seen the Lord and that the Lord had spoken to Him, and how in Damascus He had preached fearlessly in the name of Jesus.

verses.kjv: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.
verses.modern: So Saul stayed with them and moved about freely in Jerusalem, speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.

verses.kjv: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
verses.modern: He talked and debated with the Hellenistic Jews, but they tried to kill him.

verses.kjv: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
verses.modern: When the brothers learned of this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

verses.kjv: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
verses.modern: Then the church throughout Judaea, Galilee, and Samaria enjoyed a time of peace and was strengthened. Living in the fear of the Lord and encouraged by the Holy Ghost, it increased in numbers.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
verses.modern: As Peter traveled about the country, he went to visit the Lord's people who lived at Lydda.

verses.kjv: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.
verses.modern: There he found a man named Aeneas, who had been paralyzed and bedridden for eight years.

verses.kjv: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.
verses.modern: "Aeneas," Peter said to him, "Jesus Christ heals You. Get up and roll up Your mat." Immediately Aeneas got up.

verses.kjv: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.
verses.modern: All those who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw Him and turned to the Lord.

verses.kjv: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
verses.modern: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha — which in Greek is Dorcas. She was always doing good and helping the poor.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.
verses.modern: About that time she became sick and died. Her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.

verses.kjv: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.
verses.modern: Lydda was near Joppa; so when the disciples heard that Peter was in Lydda, they sent two men to him and urged him, "Please come at once!"

verses.kjv: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.
verses.modern: Peter went with them, and when he arrived he was taken upstairs to the room. All the widows stood around him, crying and showing him the robes and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.

verses.kjv: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
verses.modern: Peter sent them all out of the room; then he got down on his knees and prayed. Turning toward the dead woman, he said, "Tabitha, get up." She opened her eyes, and seeing Peter she sat up.

verses.kjv: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
verses.modern: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Then he called the believers and the widows and presented her to them alive.

verses.kjv: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.
verses.modern: This became known all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
verses.modern: Peter stayed in Joppa for some time with a tanner named Simon.

chapters.summary: Saul was struck down by a light from heaven on the road to Damascus, and the Lord Jesus spoke to him directly. Ananias laid hands on him, his sight was restored, and he was baptized. Saul immediately began preaching Christ in the synagogues, and the disciples in Jerusalem eventually accepted him through Barnabas.

verses.kjv: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,
verses.modern: At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion in what was known as the Italian Regiment.

verses.kjv: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.
verses.modern: He and all his household were devout and God-fearing; He gave generously to those in need and prayed to God regularly.

verses.kjv: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.
verses.modern: One day at about three in the afternoon He had a vision. He distinctly saw an angel of God, Who came to Him and said, "Cornelius!"

verses.kjv: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.
verses.modern: Cornelius stared at him in fear. "What is it, Lord?" he asked. The angel answered, "Your prayers and gifts to the poor have come up as a memorial offering before God."

verses.kjv: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:
verses.modern: "Now send men to Joppa to bring back a man named Simon who is called Peter."

verses.kjv: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
verses.modern: "He is staying with Simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea."

verses.kjv: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
verses.modern: When the angel who spoke to him had gone, Cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier who was one of his attendants.

verses.kjv: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
verses.modern: He told them everything that had happened and sent them to Joppa.

verses.kjv: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
verses.modern: About noon the following day, as the men were on their journey and approaching the city, Peter went up on the roof to pray.

verses.kjv: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
verses.modern: He became hungry and wanted something to eat, and while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.

verses.kjv: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
verses.modern: He saw heaven opened and something like a large sheet being let down to earth by its four corners.

verses.kjv: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
verses.modern: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals, as well as reptiles and birds.

verses.kjv: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
verses.modern: Then a voice told him, "Get up, Peter. Kill and eat."

verses.kjv: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
verses.modern: "Surely not, Lord!" Peter replied. "I have never eaten anything impure or unclean."

verses.kjv: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
verses.modern: The voice spoke to him a second time: "Do not call anything impure that God has made clean."

verses.kjv: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
verses.modern: This happened three times, and immediately the sheet was taken back to heaven.

verses.kjv: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,
verses.modern: While Peter was wondering about the meaning of the vision, the men sent by Cornelius found out where Simon's house was and stopped at the gate.

verses.kjv: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.
verses.modern: They called out, asking if Simon who was known as Peter was staying there.

verses.kjv: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
verses.modern: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Spirit said to Him, "Three men are looking for You."

verses.kjv: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.
verses.modern: "Get up and go downstairs. Do not hesitate to go with them, for I have sent them."

verses.kjv: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
verses.modern: Peter went down and said to the men, "I'm the one you're looking for. Why have you come?"

verses.kjv: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
verses.modern: The men replied, "We have come from Cornelius the centurion. He is a righteous and God-fearing man, who is respected by all the Jewish people. A holy angel told Him to ask you to come to His house so that He could hear what you have to say."

verses.kjv: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
verses.modern: Then Peter invited the men into the house to be his guests. The next day Peter started out with them, and some of the believers from Joppa went along.

verses.kjv: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
verses.modern: The following day he arrived in Caesarea. Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.

verses.kjv: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
verses.modern: As Peter entered the house, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet in reverence.

verses.kjv: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
verses.modern: But Peter made him get up. "Stand up," he said, "I am only a man myself."

verses.kjv: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.
verses.modern: While talking with him, Peter went inside and found a large gathering of people.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
verses.modern: He said to them: "You are well aware that it is against our law for a Jew to associate with or visit a Gentile. But God has shown me that I should not call anyone impure or unclean."

verses.kjv: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
verses.modern: "So when I was sent for, I came without raising any objection. May I ask why you sent for me?"

verses.kjv: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
verses.modern: Cornelius answered: "Four days ago I was fasting until this hour. At three in the afternoon I was praying in my house, when suddenly a man in shining clothes stood before me

verses.kjv: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.
verses.modern: and said, 'Cornelius, God has heard your prayer and remembered your gifts to the poor.'"

verses.kjv: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.
verses.modern: "'Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, who lives by the sea.'"

verses.kjv: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
verses.modern: "So I sent for you immediately, and it was good of you to come. Now we are all here in the presence of God to listen to everything the Lord has commanded you to tell us."

verses.kjv: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
verses.modern: Then Peter began to speak: "I now truly see that God shows no favoritism,"

verses.kjv: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
verses.modern: "but accepts from every nation the one who fears him and does what is right."

verses.kjv: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)
verses.modern: "You know the message God sent to the people of Israel, announcing the good news of peace through Jesus Christ, Who is Lord of all."

verses.kjv: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
verses.modern: "You know what has happened throughout the province of Judaea, beginning in Galilee after the baptism that John preached —"

verses.kjv: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
verses.modern: "how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and power, and how He went around doing good and healing all who were under the power of the devil, because God was with Him."

verses.kjv: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:
verses.modern: "We are witnesses of everything He did in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem. They killed Him by hanging Him on a tree,"

verses.kjv: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;
verses.modern: "but God raised Him from the dead on the third day and caused Him to be seen."

verses.kjv: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
verses.modern: "He was not seen by all the people, but by witnesses whom God had already chosen — by us who ate and drank with Him after He rose from the dead."

verses.kjv: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
verses.modern: "He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that he is the one whom God appointed as judge of the living and the dead."

verses.kjv: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
verses.modern: "All the prophets testify about Him that everyone who believes in Him receives forgiveness of sins through His name."

verses.kjv: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
verses.modern: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all who heard the message.

verses.kjv: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
verses.modern: The circumcised believers who had come with Peter were astonished that the gift of the Holy Ghost had been poured out even on Gentiles.

verses.kjv: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,
verses.modern: For they heard them speaking in tongues and praising God. Then Peter said,

verses.kjv: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
verses.modern: "Surely no one can stand in the way of their being baptized with water. They have received the Holy Ghost just as we have."

verses.kjv: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
verses.modern: So He ordered that they be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked Peter to stay with them for a few days.

chapters.summary: The centurion Cornelius received a vision from God directing him to send for Peter, and Peter received a vision declaring all foods clean. Peter went to Cornelius's house and preached the gospel, and the Holy Ghost fell on the Gentiles, who spoke in tongues and were baptized.

verses.kjv: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
verses.modern: The apostles and the believers throughout Judaea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.

verses.kjv: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
verses.modern: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers criticized him

verses.kjv: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
verses.modern: and said, "You went into the house of uncircumcised men and ate with them."

verses.kjv: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,
verses.modern: Starting from the beginning, Peter explained everything to them precisely as it had happened.

verses.kjv: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
verses.modern: "I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision. I saw something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came down to where I was."

verses.kjv: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
verses.modern: "I looked into it and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds."

verses.kjv: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
verses.modern: "Then I heard a voice telling me, 'Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.'"

verses.kjv: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
verses.modern: "'Surely not, Lord!' I replied. 'Nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.'"

verses.kjv: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
verses.modern: "The voice spoke from heaven a second time: 'Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.'"

verses.kjv: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
verses.modern: "This happened three times, and then it was all pulled up to heaven again."

verses.kjv: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.
verses.modern: "Right then three men who had been sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying."

verses.kjv: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:
verses.modern: "The Spirit told me to have no hesitation about going with them. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man's house."

verses.kjv: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
verses.modern: "He told us how he had seen an angel appear in his house and say, 'Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.'"

verses.kjv: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.
verses.modern: "'He will bring you a message through which you and all your household will be saved.'"

verses.kjv: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
verses.modern: "As I began to speak, the Holy Ghost came on them as He had come on us at the beginning."

verses.kjv: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.
verses.modern: "Then I remembered what the Lord had said: 'John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Ghost.'"

verses.kjv: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?
verses.modern: "So if God gave them the same gift He gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, Who was I to think that I could stand in God's way?"

verses.kjv: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
verses.modern: When they heard this, they had no further objections and praised God, saying, "So then, God has granted even the Gentiles repentance to life."

verses.kjv: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
verses.modern: Now those who had been scattered by the persecution that broke out when Stephen was killed traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, spreading the word only among Jews.

verses.kjv: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.
verses.modern: Some of them, however, men from Cyprus and Cyrene, went to Antioch and began to speak to Greeks also, telling them the good news about the Lord Jesus.

verses.kjv: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.
verses.modern: The Lord's hand was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.

verses.kjv: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
verses.modern: News of this reached the church in Jerusalem, and they sent Barnabas to Antioch.

verses.kjv: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
verses.modern: When he arrived and saw what the grace of God had done, He was glad and encouraged them all to remain true to the Lord with all their hearts.

verses.kjv: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
verses.modern: He was a good man, full of the Holy Ghost and faith, and a great number of people were brought to the Lord.

verses.kjv: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
verses.modern: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul.

verses.kjv: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
verses.modern: When he found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year Barnabas and Saul met with the church and taught great numbers of people. The disciples were called Christians first at Antioch.

verses.kjv: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
verses.modern: During this time some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

verses.kjv: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.
verses.modern: One of them, named Agabus, stood up and through the Spirit predicted that a severe famine would spread over the entire Roman world. This happened during the reign of Claudius.

verses.kjv: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:
verses.modern: The disciples, as each one was able, decided to provide help for the brothers and sisters living in Judaea.

verses.kjv: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
verses.modern: This they did, sending their gift to the elders by Barnabas and Saul.

chapters.summary: Peter reported to the Jerusalem church how God gave the Holy Ghost to the Gentiles, and the brethren glorified God, saying He had also granted repentance to the Gentiles. The scattered believers preached the word as far as Antioch, where Barnabas and Saul taught a great number, and the disciples were first called Christians.

verses.kjv: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.
verses.modern: It was about this time that King Herod arrested some who belonged to the church, intending to persecute them.

verses.kjv: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
verses.modern: He had James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword.

verses.kjv: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
verses.modern: When he saw that this met with approval among the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This happened during the Festival of Unleavened Bread.

verses.kjv: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.
verses.modern: After arresting him, he put him in prison, handing him over to be guarded by four squads of four soldiers each. Herod intended to bring him out for public trial after Easter.

verses.kjv: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
verses.modern: So Peter was kept in prison, but the church was earnestly praying to God for Him.

verses.kjv: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.
verses.modern: The night before Herod was to bring him to trial, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, and sentries stood guard at the entrance.

verses.kjv: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.
verses.modern: Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up. "Quick, get up!" he said, and the chains fell off Peter's wrists.

verses.kjv: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.
verses.modern: Then the angel said to him, "Put on your clothes and sandals." And Peter did so. "Wrap your cloak around you and follow me," the angel told him.

verses.kjv: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.
verses.modern: Peter followed him out of the prison, but he had no idea that what the angel was doing was really happening; he thought he was seeing a vision.

verses.kjv: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.
verses.modern: They passed the first and second guards and came to the iron gate leading to the city. It opened for them by itself, and they went through it. When they had walked the length of one street, suddenly the angel left him.

verses.kjv: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
verses.modern: Then Peter came to himself and said, "Now I know without a doubt that the Lord has sent His angel and rescued me from Herod's clutches and from everything the Jewish people were hoping would happen."

verses.kjv: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.
verses.modern: When this had dawned on him, he went to the house of Mary the mother of John, also called Mark, where many people had gathered and were praying.

verses.kjv: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.
verses.modern: Peter knocked at the outer entrance, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer the door.

verses.kjv: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for joy, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
verses.modern: When she recognized Peter's voice, she was so overjoyed she ran back without opening the door and exclaimed, "Peter is at the door!"

verses.kjv: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.
verses.modern: "You're out of your mind," they told her. When she kept insisting that it was so, they said, "It must be his angel."

verses.kjv: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.
verses.modern: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astonished.

verses.kjv: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.
verses.modern: Peter motioned with his hand for them to be quiet and described how the Lord had brought Him out of prison. "Tell James and the other brothers and sisters about this," he said, and then he left for another place.

verses.kjv: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.
verses.modern: In the morning, there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.

verses.kjv: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.
verses.modern: After Herod had a thorough search made for him and did not find him, he cross-examined the guards and ordered that they be executed. Then Herod went from Judaea to Caesarea and stayed there.

verses.kjv: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's country.
verses.modern: He had been quarreling with the people of Tyre and Sidon; they now joined together and sought an audience with him. After securing the support of Blastus, a trusted personal servant of the king, they asked for peace, because they depended on the king's country for their food supply.

verses.kjv: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
verses.modern: On the appointed day Herod, wearing his royal robes, sat on his throne and delivered a public address to the people.

verses.kjv: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.
verses.modern: They shouted, "This is the voice of a god, not of a man."

verses.kjv: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
verses.modern: Immediately, because Herod did not give praise to God, an angel of the Lord struck Him down, and He was eaten by worms and died.

verses.kjv: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
verses.modern: But the word of God continued to spread and flourish.

verses.kjv: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.
verses.modern: When Barnabas and Saul had finished their mission, they returned from Jerusalem, taking with them John, also called Mark.

chapters.summary: Herod killed James the brother of John and imprisoned Peter, but an angel of the Lord delivered Peter from prison by night. Herod searched for Peter without success and later accepted divine praise from the crowd at Caesarea; an angel of the Lord struck him, and he was eaten of worms and died.

verses.kjv: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
verses.modern: Now in the church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

verses.kjv: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
verses.modern: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Ghost said, "Set apart for Me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them."

verses.kjv: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
verses.modern: So after they had fasted and prayed, they placed their hands on them and sent them off.

verses.kjv: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
verses.modern: The two of them, sent on their way by the Holy Ghost, went down to Seleucia and sailed from there to Cyprus.

verses.kjv: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.
verses.modern: When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. John was with them as their helper.

verses.kjv: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Barjesus:
verses.modern: They traveled through the whole island until they came to Paphos. There they met a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Bar-Jesus,

verses.kjv: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.
verses.modern: who was an attendant of the proconsul, Sergius Paulus. The proconsul, an intelligent man, sent for Barnabas and Saul because he wanted to hear the word of God.

verses.kjv: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
verses.modern: But Elymas the sorcerer — for that is what his name means — opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul from the faith.

verses.kjv: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,
verses.modern: Then Saul, who was also called Paul, filled with the Holy Ghost, looked straight at Elymas

verses.kjv: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
verses.modern: and said, "You are a child of the devil and an enemy of everything that is right! You are full of all kinds of deceit and trickery. Will you never stop perverting the right ways of the Lord?"

verses.kjv: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
verses.modern: "Now the hand of the Lord is against you. You are going to be blind for a time, not even able to see the light of the sun." Immediately mist and darkness came over Him, and He groped about, seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

verses.kjv: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
verses.modern: When the proconsul saw what had happened, he believed, for he was amazed at the teaching about the Lord.

verses.kjv: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
verses.modern: From Paphos, Paul and his companions sailed to Perga in Pamphylia, where John left them to return to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
verses.modern: From Perga they went on to Antioch in Pisidia. On the Sabbath they entered the synagogue and sat down.

verses.kjv: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
verses.modern: After the reading from the Law and the Prophets, the leaders of the synagogue sent word to them, saying, "Brothers, if you have a word of exhortation for the people, please speak."

verses.kjv: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.
verses.modern: Standing up, Paul motioned with his hand and said: "Fellow Israelites and you Gentiles who worship God, listen to me."

verses.kjv: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
verses.modern: "The God of the people of Israel chose our ancestors; he made the people prosper during their stay in Egypt and with mighty power He led them out of that country."

verses.kjv: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
verses.modern: "For about forty years He endured their conduct in the wilderness."

verses.kjv: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
verses.modern: "And when He had destroyed seven nations in Canaan, He gave their land to His people as their inheritance."

verses.kjv: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
verses.modern: "All this took about 450 years. After this, God gave them judges until the time of Samuel the prophet."

verses.kjv: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
verses.modern: "Then the people asked for a king, and he gave them Saul son of Kish, of the tribe of Benjamin, who ruled for forty years."

verses.kjv: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
verses.modern: "After removing Saul, he made David their king. God testified concerning Him: 'I have found David son of Jesse, a man after My own heart; he will do everything I want him to do.'"

verses.kjv: Of this man's seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
verses.modern: "From this man's descendants God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus, as He promised."

verses.kjv: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
verses.modern: "Before the coming of Jesus, John preached repentance and baptism to all the people of Israel."

verses.kjv: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.
verses.modern: "As John was completing his work, he said: 'Who do you suppose I am? I am not the one You are looking for. But there is someone coming after me whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.'"

verses.kjv: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
verses.modern: "Fellow children of Abraham and you God-fearing Gentiles, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent."

verses.kjv: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.
verses.modern: "The people of Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus, yet in condemning Him they fulfilled the words of the prophets that are read every Sabbath."

verses.kjv: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
verses.modern: "Though they found no proper ground for a death sentence, they asked Pilate to have him executed."

verses.kjv: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
verses.modern: "When they had carried out all that was written about Him, they took Him down from the tree and laid Him in a tomb."

verses.kjv: But God raised him from the dead:
verses.modern: "But God raised him from the dead,"

verses.kjv: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
verses.modern: "and for many days He was seen by those who had traveled with Him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now His witnesses to our people."

verses.kjv: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
verses.modern: "We tell you the good news: what God promised our ancestors

verses.kjv: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
verses.modern: He has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it is written in the second Psalm: 'You are My Son; today have I begotten You.'"

verses.kjv: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
verses.modern: "God raised him from the dead so that He will never be subject to decay. As God has said, 'I will give you the sure mercies of David.'"

verses.kjv: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.modern: "So it is also stated elsewhere: 'You will not let your Holy One see decay.'"

verses.kjv: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
verses.modern: "Now when David had served God's purpose in His own generation, He fell asleep; He was buried with His ancestors and His body decayed."

verses.kjv: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
verses.modern: "But the One whom God raised from the dead did not see decay."

verses.kjv: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
verses.modern: "Therefore, my friends, I want You to know that through Jesus the forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to You."

verses.kjv: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
verses.modern: "Through Him everyone who believes is justified from everything you could not be justified from by the law of Moses."

verses.kjv: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
verses.modern: "Take care that what the prophets have said does not happen to You:"

verses.kjv: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
verses.modern: "'Look, You scoffers, wonder and perish, for I am going to do something in your days that you would never believe, even if someone told you.'"

verses.kjv: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
verses.modern: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people invited them to speak further about these things on the next Sabbath.

verses.kjv: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
verses.modern: When the congregation was dismissed, many of the Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, who talked with them and urged them to continue in the grace of God.

verses.kjv: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.
verses.modern: On the next Sabbath almost the whole city gathered to hear the word of the Lord.

verses.kjv: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
verses.modern: When the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy. They began to contradict what Paul was saying and heaped abuse on him.

verses.kjv: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
verses.modern: Then Paul and Barnabas answered them boldly: "We had to speak the word of God to you first. Since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life, we now turn to the Gentiles."

verses.kjv: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
verses.modern: "For this is what the Lord has commanded us: 'I have made you a light for the Gentiles, that you may bring salvation to the ends of the earth.'"

verses.kjv: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
verses.modern: When the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and honored the word of the Lord; and all who were appointed for eternal life believed.

verses.kjv: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.
verses.modern: The word of the Lord spread through the whole region.

verses.kjv: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
verses.modern: But the Jewish leaders stirred up the God-fearing women of high standing and the leading men of the city. They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them from their region.

verses.kjv: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
verses.modern: So they shook the dust off their feet as a warning to them and went to Iconium.

verses.kjv: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
verses.modern: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Ghost.

chapters.summary: The Holy Ghost sent Barnabas and Saul from Antioch on the first missionary journey, and they sailed to Cyprus where Saul — now called Paul — struck the sorcerer Elymas blind. Paul preached in the synagogue at Antioch in Pisidia, declaring justification by faith in Christ, and many Gentiles believed.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
verses.modern: At Iconium Paul and Barnabas went as usual into the Jewish synagogue. They spoke so effectively that a great number of Jews and Greeks believed.

verses.kjv: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
verses.modern: But the Jews who refused to believe stirred up the other Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brothers.

verses.kjv: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
verses.modern: So Paul and Barnabas spent considerable time there, speaking boldly for the Lord, who confirmed the message of His grace by enabling them to perform signs and wonders.

verses.kjv: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
verses.modern: The people of the city were divided; some sided with the Jews, others with the apostles.

verses.kjv: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
verses.modern: There was a plot afoot among both Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, to mistreat them and stone them.

verses.kjv: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
verses.modern: But they found out about it and fled to the Lycaonian cities of Lystra and Derbe and to the surrounding country,

verses.kjv: And there they preached the gospel.
verses.modern: where they continued to preach the gospel.

verses.kjv: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:
verses.modern: In Lystra there sat a man who was lame. He had been lame from birth and had never walked.

verses.kjv: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
verses.modern: He listened to Paul as he was speaking. Paul looked directly at him, saw that he had faith to be healed

verses.kjv: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
verses.modern: and called out, "Stand up on your feet!" At that, the man jumped up and began to walk.

verses.kjv: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
verses.modern: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they shouted in the Lycaonian language, "The gods have come down to us in human form!"

verses.kjv: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
verses.modern: Barnabas they called Jupiter, and Paul they called Mercurius because he was the chief speaker.

verses.kjv: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.
verses.modern: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was just outside the city, brought bulls and wreaths to the city gates because he and the crowd wanted to offer sacrifices to them.

verses.kjv: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,
verses.modern: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard of this, they tore their clothes and rushed out into the crowd, shouting:

verses.kjv: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:
verses.modern: "Friends, why are you doing this? We too are only human, like you. We are bringing you good news, telling you to turn from these worthless things to the living God, Who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and everything in them."

verses.kjv: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.
verses.modern: "In the past, He let all nations go their own way."

verses.kjv: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
verses.modern: "Yet He has not left Himself without testimony: He has shown kindness by giving you rain from heaven and crops in their seasons; He provides you with plenty of food and fills your hearts with joy."

verses.kjv: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
verses.modern: Even with these words, they had difficulty keeping the crowd from sacrificing to them.

verses.kjv: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.
verses.modern: Then some Jews came from Antioch and Iconium and won the crowd over. They stoned Paul and dragged him outside the city, thinking he was dead.

verses.kjv: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
verses.modern: But after the disciples had gathered around him, he got up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas left for Derbe.

verses.kjv: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
verses.modern: They preached the gospel in that city and won a large number of disciples. Then they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,

verses.kjv: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.modern: strengthening the disciples and encouraging them to remain true to the faith. "We must go through many hardships to enter the kingdom of God," they said.

verses.kjv: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
verses.modern: Paul and Barnabas appointed elders for them in each church and, with prayer and fasting, committed them to the Lord, in whom they had put their trust.

verses.kjv: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
verses.modern: After going through Pisidia, they came into Pamphylia.

verses.kjv: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
verses.modern: When they had preached the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

verses.kjv: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
verses.modern: From Attalia they sailed back to Antioch, where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work they had now completed.

verses.kjv: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.
verses.modern: On arriving there, they gathered the church together and reported all that God had done through them and how He had opened a door of faith to the Gentiles.

verses.kjv: And there they abode long time with the disciples.
verses.modern: They stayed there a long time with the disciples.

chapters.summary: Paul and Barnabas preached in Iconium, fled to Lystra and Derbe, and at Lystra Paul healed a man crippled from birth. The crowd tried to worship them as gods, but Jews from Antioch and Iconium stirred up the people, stoned Paul, and left him for dead. He rose up, and they returned through the cities strengthening the disciples.

verses.kjv: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
verses.modern: Some men came down from Judaea and began teaching the brothers. They said, "Unless you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses, you cannot be saved."

verses.kjv: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
verses.modern: Paul and Barnabas strongly disagreed and debated with these men. It was decided that Paul and Barnabas, along with some others, should go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

verses.kjv: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
verses.modern: Sent on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria. They reported the conversion of the Gentiles, and this brought great joy to all the brothers.

verses.kjv: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
verses.modern: When they arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church and the apostles and elders. They reported everything God had done through them.

verses.kjv: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.
verses.modern: But some believers who belonged to the sect of the Pharisees stood up and said, "The Gentiles must be circumcised and commanded to keep the law of Moses."

verses.kjv: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.
verses.modern: The apostles and elders gathered together to consider this matter.

verses.kjv: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
verses.modern: After much debate, Peter stood up and said to them, "Brothers, you know that a long time ago God chose among us that through my mouth the Gentiles would hear the word of the gospel and believe.

verses.kjv: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;
verses.modern: God, Who knows the heart, confirmed this by giving them the Holy Ghost, just as He did to us.

verses.kjv: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
verses.modern: He made no distinction between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.

verses.kjv: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
verses.modern: So why do You put God to the test by placing on the disciples a burden that neither our fathers nor we have been able to bear?

verses.kjv: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.
verses.modern: We believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we are saved, just as they are."

verses.kjv: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
verses.modern: The whole crowd became silent and listened to Barnabas and Paul as they described the miracles and wonders God had done among the Gentiles through them.

verses.kjv: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:
verses.modern: When they finished speaking, James said, "Brothers, listen to me.

verses.kjv: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
verses.modern: Simeon has described how God first visited the Gentiles to take from them a people for His name.

verses.kjv: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
verses.modern: This agrees with the words of the prophets, as it is written:

verses.kjv: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:
verses.modern: 'After this I will return and rebuild the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will rebuild its ruins and restore it,

verses.kjv: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.
verses.modern: so that the rest of mankind may seek the Lord — all the Gentiles on whom My name is called,' says the Lord, who does all these things.

verses.kjv: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.
verses.modern: God has known all His works from the beginning of the world.

verses.kjv: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:
verses.modern: Therefore my judgment is that we should not make it difficult for the Gentiles who are turning to God.

verses.kjv: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.
verses.modern: Instead we should write to them to abstain from things polluted by idols, from sexual immorality, from things that are strangled, and from blood.

verses.kjv: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.
verses.modern: For from ancient generations Moses has had those who proclaim him in every city. He is read in the synagogues every Sabbath day."

verses.kjv: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
verses.modern: Then the apostles and elders, with the whole church, decided to send chosen men from among them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas — Judas called Barsabas, and Silas, leading men among the brothers.

verses.kjv: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:
verses.modern: They wrote a letter by their hand which said: "The apostles and elders and brothers, to the brothers of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia: Greetings.

verses.kjv: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:
verses.modern: Since we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words and unsettled your souls — saying you must be circumcised and keep the law — we gave them no such instruction.

verses.kjv: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
verses.modern: So it seemed good to us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men to you along with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

verses.kjv: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.modern: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.
verses.modern: We have therefore sent Judas and Silas, who will also report the same things to you by word of mouth.

verses.kjv: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;
verses.modern: It seemed good to the Holy Ghost and to us to place no greater burden on You than these necessary things:

verses.kjv: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.
verses.modern: Abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality. If You keep yourselves from these, You will do well. Farewell."

verses.kjv: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:
verses.modern: When the men were sent off, they went to Antioch. Gathering the congregation together, they delivered the letter.

verses.kjv: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
verses.modern: When the people read it, they rejoiced at the encouragement it gave.

verses.kjv: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.
verses.modern: Judas and Silas, who were also prophets, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.

verses.kjv: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.
verses.modern: After they had stayed there for some time, the brothers sent them off in peace to the apostles.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.
verses.modern: But Silas chose to remain there.

verses.kjv: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
verses.modern: Paul and Barnabas also stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, along with many others.

verses.kjv: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.
verses.modern: Some days later Paul said to Barnabas, "Let us go back and visit the brothers in every city where we preached the word of the Lord, and see how they are doing."

verses.kjv: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
verses.modern: Barnabas wanted to take with them John, who was called Mark.

verses.kjv: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
verses.modern: Paul did not think it wise to take him, since he had left them in Pamphylia and had not gone with them to the work.

verses.kjv: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
verses.modern: There was such a sharp disagreement between them that they parted ways. Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus.

verses.kjv: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
verses.modern: Paul chose Silas and left, commended by the brothers to the grace of God.

verses.kjv: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.
verses.modern: He traveled through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.

chapters.summary: Men from Judaea insisted that Gentile believers must be circumcised to be saved, so Paul and Barnabas went to Jerusalem for the apostles and elders to settle the matter. James declared that Gentiles should not be burdened with the law beyond a few necessary things, and the council sent a letter confirming this decision. Paul and Barnabas parted ways over John Mark, with Barnabas sailing to Cyprus and Paul choosing Silas for his second journey.

verses.kjv: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:
verses.modern: Paul came to Derbe and then to Lystra. A disciple was there named Timotheus, the son of a Jewish woman who believed, but his father was a Greek.

verses.kjv: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.
verses.modern: He was spoken well of by the brothers at Lystra and Iconium.

verses.kjv: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.
verses.modern: Paul wanted Timothy to travel with him. He took him and circumcised him because of the Jews in that region, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

verses.kjv: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.
verses.modern: As they traveled through the cities, they delivered to the believers the decisions that had been handed down by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.
verses.modern: So the churches were strengthened in the faith and grew in number every day.

verses.kjv: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,
verses.modern: They traveled through Phrygia and the region of Galatia, having been kept by the Holy Ghost from preaching the word in Asia.

verses.kjv: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.
verses.modern: When they came to Mysia, they tried to enter Bithynia, but the Spirit did not allow them.

verses.kjv: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.
verses.modern: Passing by Mysia, they went down to Troas.

verses.kjv: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
verses.modern: A vision appeared to Paul during the night — a man of Macedonia was standing and appealing to him, saying, "Come over to Macedonia and help us."

verses.kjv: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.
